title: Plexus scores component gold
description:
As an operator, I want plexus evaluate accuracy to score component gold, so that boxes are graded the same way we already grade mention spans.

Feature: Plexus component accuracy

  Scenario: Component identity plus span
    Given an accepted component case asset:database with evidence on models.py lines 4-6
    And the scanner emits a database component whose evidence overlaps that span
    When I run plexus evaluate accuracy for the component layer
    Then the case is a hit

  Scenario: Wrong box
    Given gold for third_party:checkr
    And the scanner emits only asset:database on that span
    When I run plexus evaluate accuracy for the component layer
    Then the case is not a correct-label hit
